name: Multi-agent systems & enterprise scale
blurb: Dec-POMDPs, factored state, AMR swarms, emergent catastrophes.
scope: How hazards arise from the interaction of many agents, and how multi-agent state can be represented tractably enough to evaluate safety over it.
query: ("multi-agent" OR "multiagent" OR "Dec-POMDP" OR "decentralized POMDP" OR "agent swarm" OR "fleet") AND ("safety" OR "hazard" OR "collision" OR "emergent" OR "cascading failure" OR "catastroph*") AND ("warehouse" OR "logistics" OR "industrial" OR "enterprise" OR "robot*" OR "AMR" OR "tool call*" OR "LLM agent*")

name: World models & representation learning
blurb: JEPA, Graph-JEPA, hyperbolic embeddings, latent prediction.
scope: Non-generative world models that predict in latent space, and graph or hyperbolic representations suited to hierarchical enterprise structure.
query: ("joint-embedding predictive" OR "JEPA" OR "world model" OR "latent dynamics" OR "latent prediction") AND ("graph" OR "relational" OR "hyperbolic" OR "Poincar*" OR "multi-agent") AND ("self-supervised" OR "action-conditioned" OR "predict*" OR "anomaly" OR "safety")

name: Learning to defer & safety interception
blurb: Sequential L2D, selective prediction, shielding, time-to-irreversibility.
scope: When a model should abstain or hand off to a human or safeguard, from the reject option through consistent surrogate losses to sequential and multi-expert deferral.
query: ("learning to defer" OR "learn to defer" OR "learning-to-defer" OR "selective prediction" OR "reject option" OR "abstention" OR "deferral") AND ("sequential" OR "reinforcement" OR "trajectory" OR "multi-step" OR "expert" OR "human-in-the-loop" OR "shield*" OR "runtime monitor*" OR "safety")

name: Edge inference & real-time constraints
blurb: TensorRT, quantisation, wireless jitter, hardware-software co-design.

query: ("edge inference" OR "edge deployment" OR "Jetson" OR "TensorRT" OR "on-device" OR "embedded GPU") AND ("deadline" OR "tail latency" OR "p99" OR "jitter" OR "worst-case" OR "hard real-time" OR "latency budget" OR "time-critical" OR "inference latency" OR "low-latency" OR "latency constraint" OR "real-time constraint" OR "real-time inference" OR "end-to-end latency") AND ("safety" OR "safety-critical" OR "graph neural" OR "GNN" OR "multi-robot" OR "multi-agent" OR "control loop" OR "robot*" OR "autonomous")
